Alex (CS): VerdantAI flagged an uptick in p99 for their summarize route. P50 ~280ms, p99 ~1.3s during their 08:00-10:00 local peak. They're on redwood/trim-13b.fp16. Customer asks for cost + tail wins, and wants no semantic drift. thinking int8 quant + per-customer region pref to us-east and prefix KV caching for repeated prefixes. who can drive quality checks and rollout?
Dana (ML): I can run the quality pipeline. please send 15-25 representative prompts (mix of long case summaries, bullet lists, and multi-turn clarifications). my pass criteria: embedding cosine >= 0.965 vs fp16 baseline AND no increase in hallucination score or critical entity dropout. will run deterministic temperature=0.0 tests.
Pri (Eng): routing + alias creation is straightforward. we can create a model alias redwood/trim-13b.int8 and a route rule to prefer us-east edge pool for VerdantAI. canary suggestion: shadow 24h -> 2% live for 4h -> 10% for 8h -> 50% 24h -> full. need a small warm cache capacity bump to avoid cold-KV tail.
Omar (Ops): agree shadow-first. i'll add dashboard widgets: per-customer p50/p95/p99, fallback %, token delta, and a heatmap for prefix hit rate. alert if p99 > 1s or fallback > 1% sustained 10m. prefer Wed 14:00 UTC window for live steps.
Alex (CS): customer objective: p50 < 350ms, p99 < 900ms. renewal touchpoint is in 10 days; fixing tail helps renewal discussion. i'll prepare a short transcript set and ask Verdant if they accept a shadow-only pilot first.
Dana (ML): local eval config I'm going to use:```yaml
inference:
  model: redwood/trim-13b.int8
  max_tokens: 600
  temperature: 0.0
metrics:
  - latency
  - p95
  - p99
  - embedding_cosine
  - hallucination_rate
acceptance:
  embedding_cosine: 0.965
  hallucination_delta: 0.0
```
Dana (ML): will run the eval and post numeric diffs within 24h. if any clinical/entity drop we abort.
Pri (Eng): ops checklist i'll take: 1) PR for model alias + per-customer routing rule 2) autoscale min replicas bump PR 3) smoke test scripts 4) optional KV warmup job. smoke curl example below:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood/trim-13b.int8","input":"<sample long case summary>"}'
```
Omar (Ops): i'll schedule the shadow for 3932180000 (24h) and the canary window for Wed 14:00 UTC if eval looks good. i'll also instrument prefix frequency logging for 48h to pick caching keys and TTL.
Alex (CS): action items: Alex->customer comms + transcripts; Dana->eval + numbers; Pri->routing PR + smoke + warmup; Omar->dashboard + schedule + prefix logging. i'll add Renewal lead to the thread.
CanaryBot: Shadow run scheduled for 3932180000. Canary window tentatively booked for 3932240000 (Wed 14:00 UTC). Readiness checks: alias present, dashboard created, smoke tests passing. :gear:
Dana (ML): quick note: will include a semantic diff check in the pipeline (weighted entity recall). if weighted recall drops > 0.5% we stop.
Pri (Eng): keeping PRs small and with a quick revert path. will tag deploys and include rollback script.
Omar (Ops): i'll add runbook checklist: monitor latencies, fallback rate, error rate, token spend, and customer reported anomalies. i'll set a revert trigger if fallback>2% or p99>1.2s sustained 10m.
Alex (CS): thanks team. i'll ping Verdant with proposed shadow plan and timeline. will update thread when prompts arrive. :thumbsup:
